steps.description: Take the sign containing the house of interest
steps.name: house_sign

steps.description: Find the sign occupied by the lord of that house
steps.name: lord_sign

steps.description: Count signs from the house of interest to the sign containing its lord, zodiacally
steps.name: count_to_lord

steps.description: Count the same number of signs from the sign containing the lord
steps.detail: 9 signs from Aquarius ends in Libra
steps.name: advance_from_lord

steps.description: If the sign found is the 1st or 7th from the original, take the 10th sign from it; otherwise no change
steps.detail: Libra is the 5th from Gemini, neither 1st nor 7th — no change
steps.name: apply_exception

steps.description: The resulting sign contains the arudha pada of the house of interest
steps.name: arudha_pada
